title: Summer Garden
description_en:
This triptych is about a garden from my childhood.
About summer cottages, warm neighborly bonds, and flowers that grew “just because,” yet felt like the most beautiful in the world.

Lilies, peonies, and roses — the very flowers used to gather a bouquet for the first day of school: heavy and oversized for a first-grader, but deeply important.

I removed the color, leaving only the relief. This is how the shape of memory remains when details begin to fade.
cv_en: floral triptych: lily, peony, rose; relief / digital fabrication.
